name: narrowing-through-an-exported-signature
description: A library whose consumer set the fixture declares complete, so its published packages are a closed world. A type that the result of an exported function or method of its package names is not reported as a candidate for unexporting when code outside the package references that function or method, and not as a candidate for moving behind an internal boundary when code outside the target module calls it, because the caller holds values of the type. A type only its own file references, which no exported signature names, is reported as a candidate for unexporting, and a type only another package of the module names, which no exported signature names, is reported as a candidate for moving behind an internal boundary.
